name: Dark Luxury
tagline: Black, bone, and a little brass. Nothing hurried.
description: A dark-first system for premium brands. High-contrast Didone headlines, a geometric sans in light weights, hairline rules, and a lot of empty space. Brass appears in small doses and never as a gradient. Motion is slow and quiet.

fonts.role: headlines, numerals, and prices; use optical sizing

do: Use Jost uppercase at 12 or 13px with 0.24em tracking for labels and navigation
Set headlines in Bodoni Moda with optical sizing; use italics for one word of emphasis
Separate everything with 0.5px or 1px hairlines in line color
Leave at least 96px of vertical space between sections on desktop and 64px on mobile
Animate with slow fades and small vertical moves, 400ms, never springs
dont: Do not use gold gradients, metallic effects, or glow
Do not use bold weights for body text
Do not crowd a screen with more than one call to action
Do not use exclamation marks or urgency language such as "limited time"

components.name: Button
components.notes: Rectangular, uppercase Jost with wide tracking. Primary is a brass outline that fills slowly on hover; secondary is bone text with a hairline underline.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Underline-only fields with uppercase labels; focus thickens the line to brass. Error adds a small italic serif message.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Underline-only select with a fine chevron drawn in SVG.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: 14px square hairline checkbox with a brass fill. Switch is a thin line track with a small square thumb.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Uppercase micro labels with a hairline frame, no fills.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Piece card: tall image area drawn with layered tokens, serif name, reference number in small caps, price in serif.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Centered wordmark in the serif, links split left and right in tracked caps. Mobile menu is a details disclosure that opens a full-height panel.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Full-bleed dark overlay, centered panel with hairline frame, serif title, generous padding.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Specifications table: two columns, hairline rows, labels in tracked caps, values in serif.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Editorial collection grid: one oversized piece 2x2, a quote, two smaller pieces, and a craftsmanship note.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: A single serif line in italics, a hairline, and a quiet text action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Thin bar with a brass hairline on top, uppercase label and short message.
